sourcePolicy: Observed strings and candidate source formats remain distinct; collector never promotes status.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android {osVersion}; {uaModel} Build/{build}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chromeVersion} Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{appVersion};IABMV/1;]
review_notes: Candidate from the app implementation, not observed traffic. Must be checked against an independent real UA source before normalization.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android}; {model} Build/{build}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome} Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb};IABMV/1;] OR [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb};]
review_notes: Candidate only. Script randomizes app and Chrome versions, and creates build suffixes; no generated values are accepted as evidence.

evidence.quoted_text: return (f"Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android}; {model} Build/{build}; wv) " + "AppleWebKit/537.36 ... Chrome/{chrome} Mobile Safari/537.36 {fb_addon}")

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android_version}; {device_model} Build/{build_number}) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome_version} Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb_version};IABMV/1;] OR [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb_version};]
review_notes: Candidate only. This source variant omits the explicit ; wv marker used by the Motorola script; do not collapse the two shapes without observed corroboration.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {iosVersionUnderscored} like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1 [FBAN/FBIOS;FBAV/{appVersion};FBDV/{uaModel};FBMD/iPhone;]
review_notes: Candidate only. The fixed Safari Version/17.5 and Mobile/15E148 values in this implementation are not established as universal current values.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {ios_version} like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/{webkit_version} (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/{ios_build} Safari/604.1 [FBAN/FBIOS;FBAV/{fb_version};FBBV/{fb_build};FBDV/{device_model};FBMD/iPhone;FBSN/iOS;FBSV/{formatted_ios_version};FBSS/{fbss};FBID/phone;FBLC/{language};FBOP/5;FBRV/{fbrv};IABMV/1]
review_notes: Candidate only. The script mints FBRV and selects randomized WebKit/app version values; these are not backed by the current device/app catalog.

evidence.quoted_text: f"Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {ios_version} like Mac OS X) " + "AppleWebKit/{webkit_version} ... [FBAN/FBIOS;FBAV/{fb_version};FBBV/{fb_build};...;FBRV/{fbrv};IABMV/1]"

review_notes: Candidate only. SDK mapping is hard-coded; DPR-derived dpi must not be substituted for a sourced logical-density value without validation.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android {android}; {model} Build/{build}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome} Mobile Safari/537.36 Instagram {ig_version} ({api_level_pair}; {density}; {resolution}; motorola; {model}; {chipset}; {locale}; {generated_id}; IABMV/1)
review_notes: Candidate only. The generated ID, app version prefix, chipset labels and density values require independent evidence; physical PPI is not interchangeable with Android logical density.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android_full}; {model} Build/{build_number}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome_version} Mobile Safari/537.36 Instagram {instagram_version} Android ({api_level_pair}; {dpi}; {resolution}; {vendor}; {model}; {codename}; {chipset}; {lang}; {generated_id}; IABMV/1)
review_notes: Candidate only. Script generates a per-string identifier and selects random versions; exact device density and chipset token semantics need evidence.

evidence.quoted_text: f"Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android_full}; {model} Build/{build_number}; wv) " + "... Instagram {instagram_version} Android ({version_pair}; {dpi}; {resolution}; {vendor}; {model}; {codename}; {chipset}; {lang}; {unique_id}; IABMV/1)"

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {iosVersionUnderscored} like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1 Instagram {appVersion} ({uaModel}; iOS {iosVersionUnderscored}; en_US; scale={dpr}; {width}x{height}; IABMV/1)
review_notes: Candidate only. The base Safari values and app-specific token ordering require independent observed-UA corroboration.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS {ios_version} like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/{webkit_version} (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/{ios_build} Instagram {ig_version} ({device_model}; iOS {ios_version}; {language}; en-US; scale={scale}; {resolution}; IABMV/1 {generated_id})
review_notes: Candidate only. The script uses randomized WebKit/app version selection and generates the trailing app build ID.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android {osVersion}; {uaModel} Build/{build}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chromeVersion} Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/MESSENGER;FBAV/{appVersion};IABMV/1;]
review_notes: Candidate from app implementation only; needs observed Messenger Android UA and independent corroboration.

sources.name: useragent.in — In-App Browsers category
sources.datasetFile: discover from index.json; do not guess a filename
sourceNotes: The category page reports 108 in-app browser user-agent entries.
The site says in-app entries are transcribed from real observed traffic; desktop/mobile/tablet categories are generated from real components.
The page warns that not every generated cross-product row corresponds to a shipping configuration; retain row-level source classification.
The terms permit download, use, modification and redistribution including commercial use; attribution is appreciated but not required.
sources.nextAction: Fetch index.json, discover the exact In-App Browsers dataset filename, preserve raw JSON and decoder version, then ingest rows with source row IDs.

sources.name: GitHub inapp-debugger issue #16 — user-submitted observed examples
sourceNotes: Contains user-submitted iOS Facebook and Instagram in-app UA examples; sample app versions are historical and must not be mixed with current app version/build pairs.

sources.name: DeviceAtlas — mobile browser user-agent strings
sourceNotes: Search index exposes a Facebook iOS in-app sample and explains the distinction between Safari and embedded WebViews.

sources.name: Appy — in-app browser checker
sourceNotes: Describes in-app browser behavior and an Instagram sample shape; corroboration is still required for any verified NEXORA template.
